senses.gloss:
औलूक औलूक, अम्, n. (fr. उलूक), a number
of owls.

औलूक्य, a patronymic from Ulūka; (अस्), m. a
follower of the Vaiśeṣika doctrine; (‘like an owl;’
this etymology, and perhaps the epithet itself, owes
its origin to controversial animosity.)
—औलूक्य-
दर्शन, अम्, n., N. of the system of these philo-
sophers treated of in the Sarvadarśana-saṅgraha.

औलूखल औलूखल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. उलूखल),
coming from a mortar; ground or pounded in a
mortar.
